q: Quantum computation is literally Hamiltonian dynamics on Hilbert space: the computation is the orbit of |0⟩^{⊗n} under:
exp: Quantum computation: the state evolves as |ψ(t)⟩ = U(t)|0⟩^{⊗n} where U(t) = e^{-iHt} for a (time-dependent) Hamiltonian H. Gates decompose U into elementary unitaries. Measurement extracts classical information from the quantum orbit.
